ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the attached figure, there is one row of five squares arranged horizontally; inside the leftmost square is 10, the three consecutive squares in the middle are empty, and inside the rightmost square is 130. Then reason: let the three empty squares from left to right be x, y, z respectively, where y is the middle number asked by the problem. According to the conditions, the sum of the first three numbers is 100, so 10+x+y=100, that is, x+y=90. The sum of the middle three numbers is 200, so x+y+z=200. Substituting x+y=90 gives z=110. The sum of the last three numbers is 300, so y+z+130=300. Substituting z=110 gives y+110+130=300, therefore y=60.

method.method_draft: Read the image as five positions a1 through a5 with a1=10, a5=130, and the unknown middle position a3 being requested. Use the text sums S1=a1+a2+a3=100, S2=a2+a3+a4=200, and S3=a3+a4+a5=300. Combine them to isolate the center: S1+S3-S2 = a1+a3+a5, since a2 and a4 cancel.
